rule: Every LITD project must materially express all seven pillars, although their mechanical implementation may differ by project.

pillars.non_negotiable: Physical action, vulnerability and consequence must matter in the chosen form of the project.
Knowledge, art, memory, interpretation or understanding must materially affect how the world is perceived or approached.
Collective choices, institutions or power must have causes, beneficiaries, victims and consequences.
Fear must arise from a real stake, uncertainty, loss or responsibility rather than empty spectacle.
The universe must preserve a credible possibility of rebuilding, caring, creating, transmitting or continuing.

pillars.core_question: Que se passe-t-il lorsque le sens se fracture ?
pillars.non_negotiable: Fracture of perception or meaning must have readable causes and consequences and must not be reduced to arbitrary randomness or caricature.

pillars.core_question: Qu'est-ce qui mérite encore d'être protégé, compris ou reconstruit ?
pillars.non_negotiable: Every LITD work must create a meaningful lived tension between light and darkness, literal or symbolic.
